mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate indicates a growing economy, leading to higher consumer spending and increased demand for goods and services, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle, leading to decreased borrowing and spending, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive during periods of high federal funds rates (t-test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate indicates a strong labor market, leading to increased consumer confidence and spending, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts indicates growing demand for new homes, leading to increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of high housing starts (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production indicates growing supply and economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of high industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between the federal funds rate and the consumer price index indicates the monetary policy stance, with high rates and low inflation leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive during periods of high federal funds rates and low inflation (t-test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between the unemployment rate and payroll employment indicates the labor market conditions, with low unemployment and high employment leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of low unemployment and high employment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between GDP growth rate and housing starts indicates the demand for goods and services, with high GDP growth and high housing starts leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of high GDP growth and high housing starts (t-test p > 0.05).
